text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf corners me one day, a<n>serious
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I realize this is sudden, but would you<n>join me on
an errand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I fear I may not have the strength to<n>go alone...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What could have daunted Symboli<n>Rudolf so
badly? Curious, I decide to<n>go with her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She leads me to a T-shirt shop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My bicycle is two-tired... "My<n>calendar's days are
numbered"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. This store is truly dangerous.<n>Had I come
alone, I daresay I would<n>be clutching my sides at
this very<n>moment.
choice_data_list: So this place sells punny T-shirts?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, precisely. Despite their<n>unassuming
typeface, each one<n>carries a marvelous display of
wit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I discovered this shop in the course<n>of my endless
search for new puns.<n>I've always wanted to
browse<n>through it properly.
choice_data_list: Do you often go searching for new jokes?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dedication is the soul of wit. Never<n>stop practicing,
and always be on the<n>lookout for new material.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or so it says in my copy of "Comedy<n>for
Dummies," at any rate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's quite the enlightening read. I<n>could lend it to
you, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have but to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, to the point. Armed with one of<n>these
T-shirts, I fancy I could have<n>the entire academy
doubled over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you think?
choice_data_list: These gags might be a bit advanced.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You raise a good point. Not<n>everybody will
appreciate such subtle<n>humor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It may very well fall flat, and then<n>what would be
the point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll hold off on debuting one<n>of these
shirts in public for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, with that said...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to purchase one, at least.<n>My
signature punwear, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you suppose you could help me<n>pick one out?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We enter the shop and spend a while<n>browsing
T-shirts together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahahaha! Oh, this is priceless!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Doing our best to keep straight faces,<n>we settle on
a favorite and leave with<n>a new shirt and a fond
memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would, wouldn't I? I can only<n>imagine the howls
of laughter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be long before the entire<n>academy
was plunged into chaos...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I'd be opening Pandora's box.<n>Thank you for
bringing me to my<n>senses.
